name: Vercel
tagline: Git-connected deploys, projects, domains, env vars.
firstWin: your first project deployed and its production URL live
path: confirm the framework preset and deploy
open the production URL when the build finishes
optional: Custom domains and environment variables are set per-project after the first deploy.

knowledge.text: Add New → Project lets you import a Git repo. Vercel auto-detects the framework (Next.js, Vite, etc.) — usually no config needed.
Environment variables are set per project under Settings → Environment Variables, and apply to Production/Preview/Development.
Every deploy gets a vercel.app URL. Add a custom domain under the project's Domains tab.
